frequency_question: How often does an executive actor implement declared major unilateral tariffs within the stated window when possessing the legal power and stated intent?
membership_rule: Includes formal, public executive announcements of specific tariff rates on specific partner nations implemented via executive order or trade statute authorities. Excludes purely rhetorical threats that were never formally signed or advanced to implementation scheduling.
window: Within 6 months of initial formal declaration
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major instances identified; comprehensive for explicit unilateral tariff declarations by U.S. presidents meeting the criteria.
known_gaps: Some minor or secondary threatened actions may have been omitted, but all major structural tariff declarations are captured.
skeleton: Executive actions with explicit intent and statutory authority
validity_reason: Valid through the duration of the current executive administration's governing style and statutory trade powers.
